contentPattern.structure: teaser grid built from a hand-authored DA sheet (image + linked title + description per row, authored order)

config.source: path to a DA sheet ending in .json, e.g. /us/en/magazine/query-index.json (columns: path, title, description, image)

suitableFor: curated article/teaser grids driven by a DA sheet (Magazine All Articles; homepage Recent Articles / Where-do-you-want-to-go with limit)
any grid where authors control exact items and order via a sheet
notSuitableFor: auto-syncing lists of all pages in a section (use cards-index with a prefix instead)
profile bios (use profiles-wknd) or Q&A (use faq-wknd)

notes: Thin wrapper: delegates all fetching/rendering to cards-index (sheet-source mode), which reuses cards-teaser for styling. No duplicated logic. DA project, no _model file.
